header_subtitle: A new men's team enters Division 1, and three ladies' teams return to the league this season.
mens_text: For the first time in many years, HK Masters Hockey will field a men's team in the Hong Kong Hockey League, competing in the First Division. The season kicks off Friday 2 October, with fixtures every Friday night at 20:30 at the Hong Kong Football Club (HKFC).
trials_details: Trials — Friday 18 September & Friday 25 September, 20:00 at HKFC.
trials_text: All Masters-eligible players (35+) welcome, whatever your experience level.
registration_fee_description: Become a registered Masters player and receive regular updates, tournament announcements, and club news.
division_one_fee_description: Required once selected to play in the Hong Kong Hockey League First Division.
join_text: Come try out for HK's first men's Masters team in years.
ladies_text: For another season, Hong Kong Masters Hockey fields three ladies' Masters teams (35+) in the Hong Kong Hockey League, drawn from our club's Premier League players. Masters A and Masters B compete in Division 1, Masters C in Division 2.

squads.name: MO40
squads.description: The MO40 squad is a blend of experience and energy. With players drawn from Hong Kong's vibrant hockey community, this team is gearing up for a strong showing in Rotterdam.

squads.name: MO50
squads.description: The MO50 squad has a proud history on the international masters stage. Seasoned, tactical and never short of passion, this group is ready to fly the HK flag once again in Rotterdam.
